trade_price.meaning: current spot price reported by the Uniswap V2 pool, in secondTokens per OLAS
trade_price.checkpoint: before swap execution in Block N

time_weighted_average.meaning: time-weighted average price computed by UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice()

amount_out_min.meaning: minimum OLAS output accepted by the V2 swap in _performSwap()
amount_out_min.checkpoint: before V2 swap execution in Block N

olas_received.meaning: OLAS amount actually received by BuyBackBurner from the _performSwap call
olas_received.checkpoint: after swap execution in Block N

assumptions: buyBack is permissionless, so the attacker controls swap timing (asm_buyback_permissionless).
The BuyBackBurner holds secondTokens available for the buyback (p_buybacker_holds_secondtokens).
The scenario is conditional; no concrete transaction is asserted to have occurred.
limitations: Only one direct impact (imp_swap_receives_fewer_olas) is formalized; imp_after_swap_check_passes is deferred to a separate claim.
No concrete numeric value for fair market price is supplied, so the relation is stated only over the observable olas_received output rather than a fair-price comparison.
The exact arithmetic of the after-swap check is not formalized here.
Attacker pre-existing OLAS/secondToken holdings and capital are not established by the report.
